scenarios.title: name refuses ids that parse as another kind
scenarios.notes: Ids S-001-attempt-2, S-001-v0-cli-0, S-001-attempt-0, S-001-v10-a-b-3 under slice and milestone kinds. Each must raise Fail (exit 2, ok false), never print a name. parse must still read the same strings as attempt or verify.

scenarios.title: valid parts of every kind keep their names and parse back
scenarios.notes: run, slice, milestone, e2e, e2e-area, state, verify, attempt with valid parts, incl. S-fix-M-1-2 and S-001-e2e. Each name parses back to the same kind and parts under several formats.

scenarios.title: non-ASCII ids and parts are refused where parse refuses them
scenarios.notes: U+212A (Kelvin), U+017F (long s), accented letters, fullwidth digits in id, under {name} and {name:lower}. Slice id must raise Fail. Fullwidth digits in integer parts must not pass as ints.

scenarios.title: integer parts compare by value
scenarios.notes: n='02', 2, '2', ' 2', '+2', '-1', '0x2', huge digit strings, True, 2.0. Valid ones succeed and parse back by value. Invalid ones raise Fail, not an exception trace.

scenarios.title: lowering touches only the tail and follows one ASCII rule
scenarios.notes: Format Feat/PROJ-{name:lower}-X with uppercase prefix kept. e2e-area with area 'É', 'İ', 'ß'. Output must lower ASCII only and parse back. name and parse must agree.

scenarios.title: formats whose prefix or suffix joins the tail into another kind
scenarios.notes: Formats with suffix '-e2e', '-attempt-1', '-v1-a-1', numeric suffix, and prefix 'run-'. Slice id may then parse as another kind. Expect Fail, or a faithful round trip. Never a silent mismatch.

scenarios.title: state names keep the given ts and build one when absent
scenarios.notes: state with no ts builds a UTC stamp and still succeeds. Explicit 14-digit ts is used as given. A bad ts (short, letters) must raise Fail. The check must skip ts only when none was given.

scenarios.title: active_branch matches slice ids by ASCII lowering
scenarios.notes: Scratch repo, format feature/p-1-{name:lower}, S-001 in progress. Branch feature/p-1-s-001 is active. Look-alike feature/p-1-s-00K (U+212A) is not. A U+212A id in slices.json does not match the ASCII branch. Foreign branches never read as active.

scenarios.title: the name command reports refusal without side effects
scenarios.notes: Exit 2, JSON ok false, an error message that names kind and branch, empty stdout name, no change to the repo tree. Check missing --id, empty id, unknown kind, bad format.

tools.purpose: Run branches.py name and parse, and next-action.py, in scratch repos
Generate ids, parts and formats; check the round-trip property of name
Unicode case-folding samples (Kelvin, long s, dotted I, sharp s)

riskReason: One pure function and its CLI cross one boundary, and the change decides which branch names the loop trusts.
notes: Slice is code complete on sdlc/S-fix-M-1-1b. Profiles are ordered by scenario count: contract, cli, security, i18n. Medium risk caps the run at 4 profiles. No limits profile: the spec states no number.
